html:
The Gitxaała, "people of the open sea", are a Tsimshianic people of the outer northern coast of British Columbia. Their main village is Lax Klan, on Dolphin Island south of today's Prince Rupert.

They fished, hunted sea mammals and gathered seaweed and shellfish on the outer islands. They are related by language to the Tsimshian of the Skeena but count themselves a separate nation. Their neighbours by sea were the Haida to the west and the Heiltsuk and Kitasoo to the south. Their stories record early meetings with British ships in the late 1700s, when one house took a name, Heel, from an English captain.
